label: GALEX/GALEX MCAT
name: GALEX Merged Catalog of Sources
description: The GALEX Merged Catalog of Sources (MCAT) is the source catalog produced by the Galaxy Evolution Explorer (GALEX), a NASA Small Explorer mission that surveyed the sky in two ultraviolet bands, far-UV (FUV, ~1350-1750 Å) and near-UV (NUV, ~1750-2800 Å). The MCAT combines detections from individual visits and provides ultraviolet photometry and source properties for hundreds of millions of objects across the GALEX imaging surveys.
